source: build a forest and make cars you can off road them make it 3d and muddy

image_prompt.text: Vehicle-width muddy trails winding through the forest, wide enough to drive and rough enough to be a challenge
A large open clearing the whole server can work in, on a regen timer
dense forest of trees with uneven ground, deep mud and dirt patches between the trunks

layout_placement.text: cars parked at the trail heads, drivable off the trails and into the trees

notes: Preset caveat: Vehicle Sim's resource-shared extraction field came with the preset - this prompt has no resource loop at all, only driving.
Off-roading means leaving the trail, so the drivable surface is the whole forest floor rather than the roads path-road-vehicle describes.
No lap or finish condition was stated, which is why this is Vehicle Sim and not Racing.

open_questions.ask: No theme was stated beyond muddy - should the forest read as realistic wilderness, post-apocalyptic, or bright and stylized?
Is there anything to do besides drive - a route to finish, things to haul, a lap to beat?

coverage_missing.ask: What should the forest look like - realistic, stylized, seasonal?
Is this free driving, or is there a trail to complete?
How large should the forest be, and how many cars?

answers.ask: No theme was stated beyond muddy - should the forest read as realistic wilderness, post-apocalyptic, or bright and stylized?
answers.answer: Make it a realistic wilderness forest, with muddy trails, trees, rocks, and uneven off-road terrain.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do besides drive - a route to finish, things to haul, a lap to beat?
answers.answer: Keep it focused on driving; there does not need to be a route, hauling, or lap objective.
